title: Banks as Current
subtitle: Test your understanding of Banks as Current — Tartarian architectural nodes that directed aetheric current, and their inversion into financial institutions that store currency.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Tartarian banks were aetheric containment vessels on the nodal lattice grid. Piezoelectric quartz granite, sound-dressed masonry, and footings into the water table completed an Air-to-Earth circuit that shared positive free energy. After the reset those shells kept the name banks and were turned into a closed-loop harvest of currency, loosh, and monetary debt. Modern currency is the digitized mock of that original current.
